**Problem**
What is the pain point? ("When I ..., it costs/saves ..." — concrete
numbers beat abstractions.)

**Proposed solution**
What should broke do differently?

**Alternatives considered**

**Context**
- AiderDesk version
- Typical session shape: long tool loops, many files, local vs cloud model
- Any measured numbers (tokens/chars, task sizes)
